follow-on: _score repeats the contradiction veto owned by jev_review.py:638-641, so the measurement can reject an entry even if the production decision stops doing so.

follow-on: rebuilt calibration metrics and threshold come from the same frozen calibration object used to make the saved values at line 559, so this comparison cannot detect a calibration-only scoring or fitting regression.
follow-on: baseline_suite and after_suite are empty, so no added-failure count can be derived from paired source suite logs; the review records it as unknown rather than zero.
